name: reskit-turbine-library
title: RESKit turbine library, 880 turbines (derived from thewindpower.net, licensed)
description: Per-turbine CSVs in RESKit's turbine-library format -- manufacturer, model, rated capacity, usage, hub heights, rotor diameter and a full power curve -- covering 880 commercial turbine models. Built inside ICE-2 from The Wind Power's 2023 database release for the 2025 RESKit wind validation study, and usable directly as `turbine_library_path`. A superset of the 123-turbine library bundled with RESKit, and unlike that one it may not be redistributed.

ethos:upstream.note: Derived inside ICE-2 from thewindpower.net tables under a per-location subscription. Not distributed by anyone, here or upstream. The underlying tables remain purchasable from thewindpower.net. Checked 2026-09-07.

ethos:restriction: Derived from The Wind Power (thewindpower.net) under an ICE-2 database subscription, and reproducing its power curves point-for-point. Redistribution is prohibited on the same terms as the source product: it must not be communicated outside the licensed location. Studies built on it may be published as long as they carry no raw curve data. ICE-2 members on the institute HPC only; contact the RESKit maintainers for access.

sources.title: Derived from thewindpower-power-curves and thewindpower-turbines (The Wind Power database, 2023 release -- the `Source` field in each CSV reads "World Wind Farm 2023")
